The giveaway is the last hidden unit (row 32 of W1). Its first four input weights are 0.073, 0.088, 0.071, 0.067 and every other weight is exactly 0.0, its bias is exactly -1.0 so ReLU always kills it, and column 32 of W2 is all zeros. So that neuron never affects play. It is pure storage.

Reading those four weights as ASCII codes times 0.001:

| Weight | ASCII | Letter |
|---|---|---|
| 0.073 | 73 | I |
| 0.088 | 88 | X |
| 0.071 | 71 | G |
| 0.067 | 67 | C |

CODE: IXGC
